hooks.command: ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$ROOT/.env" ]; then set -a; source "$ROOT/.env"; set +a; fi; AGENTS=$(curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/companies/${SR_COMPANY_ID}/issues?status=todo,in_progress,blocked" -H 'Authorization: Bearer local-board' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; issues=json.load(sys.stdin); print(' '.join({i['assigneeAgentId'] for i in issues if i.get('assigneeAgentId')}))" 2>/dev/null); for id in $AGENTS; do npx --yes paperclipai heartbeat run --agent-id "$id" --source assignment >/dev/null 2>&1 & done
